articles.title: Coyote vs. Acme Is Now Available to Watch at Home After Its Box Office Comeback
articles.summary: Once upon a time, three years ago to be exact, it wasn’t looking like Coyote vs. Acme would ever see the light of day. However, after years of fan outcry, the movie was given a second chance, largely courtesy of a new distributor, Ketchup Entertainment.
body: After a full theatrical release, the Looney Tunes hit is now available to rent or purchase from digital platforms like Prime Video. The movie is also getting a full line of 4K Blu-rays, now up for preorder.
Coyote vs Acme is available to rent for $19.99 or purchase digitally for $24.99.

Coyote vs Acme is a live-action and animated hybrid, sort of in the vein of Space Jam. It stars Wil E. Coyote of Looney Tunes fame who, after decades of brutal injuries on the job, decides to sue ACME Corporation itself. He hires a pretty down-on-his-luck lawyer (Will Forte), and together they take on ACME’s corporate resources, headed by the lawyer Buddy Crane (John Cena).

Coyote vs Acme was originally produced on a budget of $70 million all the way back in 2023. In 2023, Warner Bros. scrapped the movie, and its reasoning was as simple as a $30 million tax write-off. Yep, it was a Bat Girl situation.

articles.title: Digger Review
articles.summary: Review: Digger's satire may not change your thinking on global warming, but there are excellent performances from Tom Cruise and the rest of the cast, and more than a few laughs.
body: "Gentlemen, we find ourselves in a dildo of a pickle," says the President of the United States as he comes to grips with the fact that a US oil-drilling mishap has split off a city-sized ice shelf that's on a path of destruction toward Europe and will trigger tsunamis, causing untold death and destruction. That line, exquisitely delivered by John Goodman and imposingly photographed by director Alejandro G. Iñárritu (Babel, Birdman, The Revenant) in his signature low, wide-angle style, also sums up my complex feelings toward a film whose reach far exceeds its grasp and whose satire—while funny—would have felt fresher a decade ago.

Starting with an ice fracture "10 times the size of his own dick," Digger follows Digger Rockwell, the oil tycoon responsible for the ice shelf debacle mentioned above, who finds himself on the defensive as he works with the president, advisors and generals to try to stop the impending doom brought on by our insatiable appetite for fossil fuels—and when that fails, at the very least, to "control the narrative."
points: Review: Digger's satire may not change your thinking on global warming, but there are excellent performances from Tom Cruise and the rest of the cast, and more than a few laughs.

articles.title: Want To Dress Up As Bryan From The Resident Evil Movie For Halloween? Here’s How
articles.summary: Halloween season is almost upon us, and if you're looking to dress up as the Resident Evil movie's in-over-his-head courier, Bryan (played by Austin Abrams), then here's a checklist of everything you need to pull off the Raccoon City look.
body: As detailed by Resident Evil News, dressing up as Bryan requires sourcing a few brand-name items and scuffing them up. The actor's main clothing consists of RVCA fatigue pants, a deep yellow plaid shirt and grey hoodie from New Yorker, and Nike Jordan Spizke low sneakers that'll need some customization. For the medical bag, if your local hospital doesn't want to sell you one, the official popcorn bag should do the trick.

The devil is in the details, so to really sell the idea that you've been through hell and back, you'll need to do some distressing on the outfit. For example, the thumbs on the gloves were cut off and replaced with stitches, and to scuff up the pants, you can use sandpaper to wear them down.

Fake blood will seal the deal, and you can easily make a bucket of the stuff with corn syrup and food coloring to nail the viscosity--a word of caution: it can be very sticky once applied. Dribble the concoction on your costume, get some friends to chuck massive water balloons at you as you sprint down a deserted street, and you'll be ready to win a few Halloween contests.

articles.title: Sony and Nintendo Should Keep the Current Gen Going for as Long as Possible 'Because People Are Very Happy Using PS5 and Switch 2,' Former PlayStation Exec Says
articles.summary: Sony and Nintendo need to make their current consoles last as long as possible amid soaring costs that have already prompted PS5 and Switch 2 price rises. That's according to former PlayStation Worldwide Studios boss Shuhei Yoshida, who told The Verge that console companies needed to focus on…
body: While there's no suggestion that Nintendo plans to launch a Switch 3 anytime soon (Switch 2 only arrived last year!), the company always devotes a chunk of its budget to researching future hardware. And upgrades to the launch Switch 2 model will undoubtedly be considered at some point, similar to the Switch Lite and Switch OLED.

As for Sony, we know that a PlayStation 6 is on the way at some point. Previously, analysts had suggested a 2028 launch seemed likely, though Sony is yet to make any official indication of when PS6 may arrive — and as time goes on, that late 2028 release date feels less and less likely. Indeed, Yoshida has suggested that console makers may now be looking to delay the arrival of next-gen hardware as long as possible.

"Sony and Nintendo have sold enough numbers of their current-generation hardware, so because of the cost of goods, they might be looking [at] pushing back the launch of next gen," Yoshida said. "I think they should try to keep the current generation as long as possible, because people are very happy using PS5 and Switch 2.

articles.title: GTA 5 For Switch Mod Project Shuts Down, Dev Thanks Take-Two For Its “Mercy”
articles.summary: The creator of a mod project that sought to bring Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 5 to Switch is closing up shop, apparently at the request of rights owner Take-Two. This action comes in the same month that Rockstar published a new "Mod Guidelines" notice informing people they need to "respect our…
body: Paralympics Productions announced ( via GamesRadar ) that it will shut down on October 3. The developer thanked people for their support and apologized for not being able to deliver GTA 5 for Switch.
He also said he's "thankful for Take-Two's mercy," which makes it sound like this situation could have been worse for the modder.
"This is the definitive end," the developer wrote. "Peace out, girl scouts."
The developer went on to say that they had received a cease-and-desist notice. He said he plans to comply with this because "I'm not an idiot." No legal action has taken place as of yet, he added.

articles.title: Sony Makes Japanese Players Prove They’re Gamers To Get A PS5 Pro
articles.summary: The demand for PlayStation 5 Pro consoles is currently outpacing supply in Japan, due to ongoing memory shortages that have yet to be resolved. Now, Sony is offering Japanese players a unique way to earn their way into a PS5 Pro lottery system, but only if they can demonstrate that they've already…
body: Sony's Japanese PlayStation blog notes that players who want to enter the PS5 Pro lottery must have 60 hours of gameplay time on their PlayStation accounts between September 2024 and September 2026. That time can be split between PlayStation 4 or PlayStation 5 consoles.

Some hardcore gamers can get in 60 hours of playtime in a week or even more. So, the threshold isn't too extreme. But it's likely in place to prevent scalpers from getting their hands on PS5 Pros and flipping them on the secondary market at greatly inflated prices.

If Japanese players meet the criteria laid out by Sony, they will be entered in the lottery system and subsequently notified that they have a chance to purchase a PS5 Pro directly from the gaming publisher. However, if any buyers fail to act on their opportunity, their systems will be offered to other players in a future lottery.

articles.title: Brendan Fraser's 124-Minute Action Thriller Classic Is Back From the Dead on Streaming
articles.summary: Brendan Fraser has had one hell of a career. He went from playing a lovable goofball in Encino Man to battling dinosaurs in Journey to the Center of the Earth, winning an Oscar for The Whale, and, of course, becoming an unlikely action hero in one of the biggest adventure franchises of the late…
body: Now, one of Fraser’s most iconic performances is suddenly having a moment on Netflix.

That movie is The Mummy, the 1999 adventure blockbuster that turned Fraser’s Rick O’Connell into an enduring pop-culture icon. The Mummy is currently climbing Netflix’s charts, just as the first major set photos from long-awaited The Mummy 4 have started making the rounds online.

The film entered Netflix's top 10 this week, according to FlixPatrol. While the new installment isn't set to release until 2027, it's never too early to jump back in and revisit the Sahara Desert thriller.

Released in 1999, The Mummy follows Rick O’Connell, an American adventurer who teams up with librarian and aspiring Egyptologist Evelyn Carnahan (Rachel Weisz) and her brother Jonathan (John Hannah) to explore the ancient Egyptian city of Hamunaptra. Unfortunately, their expedition accidentally awakens Imhotep (Arnold Vosloo), an ancient high priest cursed to live as an undead monster.

articles.title: Marvel’s Wolverine Is Holding Its Own Against PlayStation’s Live-Service Giants
articles.summary: Marvel's Wolverine might not be a critical hit, but it's doing surprisingly well commercially. The new superhero adventure from Insomniac Games faced stiff opposition from new releases and established live-service titles at launch, but according to the analytics firm Circana and its engagement…
body: For the week ending September 19, Marvel's Wolverine ranked seventh on Circana's Top 10 Titles by weekly active users in the US chart. Sandwiched between Marvel Rivals (sixth place) and Minecraft (eighth place), that's a good start for the game, which is the only single-player title in the top 10--although Minecraft players might disagree. "The average US Marvel's Wolverine player engaged with the title for 14.2 hours during the week, according to Circana's Player Engagement Tracker," Circana's Mat Piscatella wrote. "This ranked in the top 20 across all titles on PlayStation for the week."

While NBA 2K27, Fortnite, and Roblox remained on top, seventh place is still a relatively impressive feat for a game like Marvel's Wolverine, which is mostly a one-and-done experience. Unlike Marvel's Spider-Man and its bustling open-world slice of Manhattan, there's little reason to return to it beyond a New Game Plus mode that unlocks new skills, and this Wolverine game can easily be completed within a week.

articles.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Is Officially the Best-Reviewed Game of the Year
articles.summary: It's 2026. Is an 11-year-old epic RPG really the best new release you can buy? Yes — according to Metacritic, anyway. At the review aggregation site, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered sits atop the ranking of all new releases for 2026, with a sky-high 94 Metascore.
body: Now, a few caveats. This score is based on just eight reviews, so it's not the biggest sample size. And those eight reviews are all based on the PC version. Other platforms haven't amassed enough reviews to get official Metascores, although the handful of reviews for the PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and Nintendo Switch 2 versions are all in the same 9-10 range.

But the situation with The Witcher 3 Remastered is a little odd, due to how CD Projekt Red has released the new version of the game. It's technically not a new game at all; on most platforms, it's a free upgrade for owners of previous versions of The Witcher 3. On Steam, it doesn't even get a separate listing, just replacing the original game on the store and in your library.

This being the case, many publications have opted not to give Remastered a full review. That might also have had something to do with The Witcher 3 Remastered being a gigantic game and a known quantity, and review code arriving late at the busiest time of year. Those who have reviewed it, however, are seriously impressed.
points: Is an 11-year-old epic RPG really the best new release you can buy?

articles.title: Guillermo Del Toro Officially Confirms He Almost Directed the Bioshock Movie
articles.summary: Even as video game adaptations continue to be in vogue, Hollywood's white whale has been BioShock. That might come as a surprise considering just how well suited the massively influential 2007 shooter is to a cinematic take, as well as the fact that attempts at an adaptation have been happening…
body: Talking to IGN in a wide-ranging interview, del Toro casually dropped the information that he had "a couple of calls" about taking on the BioShock movie. He didn't get much further in the process, however, as these were apparently some of "the most disastrous calls I've ever had." While del Toro doesn't go on to offer up any more details on what his vision for the film would be, he said this was just one potential adaptation among a series of calls he described as "contentious."

When asked if he would ever want to adapt a video game in the future, del Toro answered bluntly: "Fuck no." That also applies to his future involvement in games, except perhaps lending his likeness to whatever Kojima creates. After the failed attempts to release Insane and Silent Hills, del Toro says, "never again."

Allegedly, we will be getting a BioShock movie relatively soon, but I refuse to believe that until I am in the theater watching the thing. The latest iteration of the project is actively in development at Netflix. It was announced in 2022 that the film would be directed by Francis Lawrence (of the Hunger Games franchise) from a script by Michael Green ( Logan, Blade Runner 2049 ).

articles.title: The Witcher 3 surges to its highest Steam concurrent player-count ever, following Remastered edition's release
articles.summary: The Witcher 3 's newly released Remastered edition has dramatically rekindled interest in the 11-year-old role-playing game, which is currently enjoying its highest concurrent player-count on Steam ever.
body: As of the time of writing, nearly 120,000 people are playing The Witcher 3 on Steam, making it the ninth most-played game on the PC platform. That of course does not include numbers from the likes of GOG and the Epic Games Store, where it's also being sold, nor the players on PlayStation, Switch 2, and Xbox.

According to Steam data-tracking website SteamDB, that's the highest concurrent player-count The Witcher 3 has ever had - higher than at its launch in 2015 (a high of 92K), and higher than the game's previous peak of 103K in January 2020, when Netflix's Witcher show was at its most popular. The other notable peak was 89K in December 2022, when the next-gen update dropped.

With a playerbase of 65 million, there's a large community to excite, but it's a reminder of how much pulling-power CD Projekt Red's fantasy RPG has, all the same. And as America wakes up and downloads the update, the question is how high can the numbers go?

According to the concert tour's official site, "Additional concerts in France, Germany, Italy and Spain are currently being planned, with details and additional cities to be announced in the near future."

The tour will kick off in North America on Feb. 22 in Chicago, followed by Europe on April 3 in London, and in Australia on May 13 in Melbourne. articles.title: You can now watch one of this year's best orchestral game-music performances, celebrating Hades 1 and 2, online for free
articles.summary: The outrageously enjoyable Hades musical orchestral concert, Ballads of the Underworld, is now available to watch in its entirety, online, for free.
body: You might recall that Hades show being one we wrote about during Eurogamer's Optimism Week, in an article about our love of game-music performances. You remembered correctly: in that article we mentioned a few shows but the Hades performance was really the spark for it.

In the show, game-maker Supergiant recreated music from the Hades series with a live orchestra - the London Mozart Players - conducted by Hades co-composer Austin Wintory. There was also live singing from Melinoë actor Judy Alice Lee, Erin Yvette (Scylla), and Colin Ryan (Apollo). Supergiant composer Darren Korb and vocalist Ashley Barret also sung their hearts out.

The video is segmented according to a setlist listed in the video's description. My personal highlights are Moonlight Guide Us at the top of the show (it's a pity the encore version didn't make it in; they had another go at it); I am Gonna Claw (Out Your Eyes Then Drown You to Death) at 16.48; Colin Ryan singing Fated Glory at 46.00 (that voice!); and Darren Korb's incredible falsetto during the final few numbers. Great show, great games, great voices!
points: The outrageously enjoyable Hades musical orchestral concert, Ballads of the Underworld, is now available to watch in its entirety, online, for free.

articles.title: Don't worry if you're struggling in human form in The Blood of Dawnwalker - "it should be harder" playing that way
articles.summary: If you've been playing Medieval vampire RPG The Blood of Dawnwalker and you're wondering why you're having a hard time during the day, as a human, versus as at night as a vampire, then don't worry: you're experiencing the game as intended. It's not supposed to be balanced, apparently.
body: "Yes, you should," game director Konrad Tomaszkiewicz told me when I asked if you should feel more powerful as a vampire, and more underpowered as a human. "You should. When I created the idea for the protagonist the Dawnwalker, it was supposed to be something like the werewolf, which in the day as a human [you are] weaker than at night.

"But it's possible to play and finish the game [as a human] and it makes you always more grounded, and it allows us to tell the stories with different antagonists or different events where you will not be overpowered, and you don't need - like in the superhero movies - to create even stronger villains every time you create a new story."

I experienced this disparity in power while playing The Blood of Dawnwalker for review. I specifically noted that where I didn't succeed in assaulting the vampire Brencis' castle in the day in human form, but instead succeeded at night as a vampire shortly after. Tomaszkiewicz unpacked a few of the reasons why the vampire form is more powerful a little later into our chat.

videos.summary: Godzilla movies have long had a problem: What do you do after the initial thrill of a quote/unquote _serious _Godzilla origin story? Can the filmmakers somehow continue the deep thematic underpinnings of that first adventure, even while upping the visual ante with more giant monster action?
body: It is under these circumstances – or should I say restrictions? – that [Godzilla Minus Zero]( enters the ring. As the sequel to the much-praised [Godzilla Minus One]( from three years ago – a picture that dealt with, among other things, notions of survivor’s guilt, hope in the face of hopelessness, found family, and more – Minus Zero is on the ropes from the start. Can returning writer-director Takashi Yamazaki wring even more out of his characters, who have already been to hell and back, while also blowin’ up stuff real good? In a word, no.
points: Godzilla movies have long had a problem: What do you do after the initial thrill of a quote/unquote _serious _Godzilla origin story?
